privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.s1.title: 1. Data Controller
privacy.s1.p1: The controller of your personal data is PAGE_OWNER_NAME, an individual operating this website (hereinafter: "Service"). Contact: PAGE_OWNER_EMAIL
privacy.s2.title: 2. What data we collect
privacy.s2.p1: In connection with using the Service, we process the following personal data:
privacy.s2.item1: Email address – required for account registration and sign-in
privacy.s2.item2: First and last name – provided upon registration or retrieved from your Google profile
privacy.s2.item3: Profile picture – optional, uploaded by user or retrieved from your Google profile
privacy.s3.title: 3. Purpose and Legal Basis for Processing
privacy.s3.p1: We process your personal data for:
privacy.s3.item1: Providing the service – creating and managing your user account (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR – performance of a contract)
privacy.s3.item2: Ensuring system security (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR – legitimate interest of the controller)
privacy.s4.title: 4. Data Recipients – Transfer to Google
privacy.s4.p1: For technical operation of the Service, we use services provided by Google LLC (United States), specifically:
privacy.s4.p2: Data transfer to the USA takes place on the basis of Standard Contractual Clauses (SCC) approved by the European Commission. Google's privacy policy is available at: policies.google.com/privacy
privacy.s5.title: 5. Data Retention Period
privacy.s5.p1: We retain your data for the duration of your account's existence. Upon account deletion, data is promptly removed from Firestore and Firebase Storage. Firebase Authentication logs may be retained by Google for an additional period according to their retention policy.
privacy.s6.title: 6. Your Rights
privacy.s6.p1: Under GDPR, you have the following rights regarding your personal data:
privacy.s6.item1: Access – right to know what personal data we hold about you
privacy.s6.item2: Rectification – right to update or correct your data at any time via the Profile page
privacy.s6.item3: Erasure – you may request deletion of your account and data by writing to PAGE_OWNER_EMAIL
privacy.s6.item4: Restriction of processing & objection – right to limit or object to the processing of your data
privacy.s6.p2: To exercise your rights, contact: PAGE_OWNER_EMAIL. You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the supervisory authority in your country.

privacy.s8.title: 8. Changes to this Privacy Policy
privacy.s8.p1: We will notify you of any changes by updating the date at the top of this page. Continued use of the Service after changes means acceptance of them.

terms.s1.p2: Using the Service means acceptance of these Terms.
terms.s2.title: 2. Definitions
terms.s2.item1: Service – the web application available at angular-firebase-accelerator.web.app
terms.s2.item2: User – any natural person who accesses the Service or creates an account
terms.s2.item3: Account – an individual user profile in the Service
terms.s3.title: 3. Terms of Use and Account Registration
terms.s3.item1: Using basic informational pages does not require registration.
terms.s3.item2: To access full features, you must create an Account (via email and password or Google Sign-In).
terms.s3.item3: You are responsible for keeping your password confidential.
terms.s3.item4: Providing false personal information is prohibited.

terms.s4.item2: Refrain from attempts to breach system security or unauthorized access to data
terms.s4.item3: Refrain from uploading unlawful content or infringing on third-party rights

terms.s5.item2: Perform technical maintenance resulting in temporary unavailability of the Service

terms.s7.title: 7. Complaints

terms.s8.title: 8. Contact

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.s1.title: 1. What are cookies and localStorage?
cookies.s1.p1: Cookies are small text files saved on your device by the browser. localStorage is a mechanism for storing data directly in the browser without an expiry date. Both mechanisms are used exclusively for technical purposes necessary for the Service to function.
cookies.s2.title: 2. What cookies we use
cookies.s2.p1: We use only necessary cookies and localStorage data – no tracking, no analytics, no advertising.
